app_events.details: Driver pressed 'I'm here' at pickup point.
Driver cancelled the trip and marked rider as no-show.
No-show fee S$4.00 charged to rider.

grace_period_min.text: Minutes, counted from the driver_arrived event, that the driver must wait before a no-show can be marked and a no-show fee charged. A no-show marked before this period ends carries no fee.

no_show_fee.text: The no-show fee in SGD charged to the rider when a valid no-show is marked.

personal_approaches_prohibited.text: Governs a driver's or rider's personal approaches to the other party. A true value means pressing the other party for contact details, personal invitations, gifts or remarks about their body or private life are not allowed on a Ryde trip.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The no-show part looks plain: driver_arrived is 12:30:00 and the no-show was marked at 12:32:40, only 2 min 40 s later, before the 3-min grace period ended, and the rider's 12:31:05 chat shows she was coming; on the numbers alone the S$4.00 fee would be refunded. What decides routing is the chat in casual Singlish: at 12:31:30 the driver asks which unit she stays in and says he can go up to find her, and at 12:32:20 calls her his pretty customer and says he will bring flowers next time, right after she asked why he wanted to know. Pressing a rider for her home unit and making personal romantic offers is a safety matter that v2.1 s5.2 sends to a person, so the S$4.00 is not decided automatically.
